تلتمسن (form VIII)
# تَلْتَمِسْنَ (taltamisna) /tal.ta.mis.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# تُلْتَمَسْنَ (tultamasna) /tul.ta.mas.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
